newsitem.title: USA: India UB group takes up 26 pct stake in Nor'Wester.
newsitem.headline: India UB group takes up 26 pct stake in Nor'Wester.

text.p: Nor'Wester Brewing Co and Willamette Valley Inc's Microbreweries across America said Thursday they signed a non-binding letter of intent with UB Group of Bangalore, India, under which UB Group plans to invest $12 million in cash, securities and management services.

In return, UB Group will receive a 26 percent stake in Nor'Wester, the sole entity that will exist following the proposed consolidation of Nor'Wester, Willamette Valley and each of Willamette Valley's four regional craft breweries.
UB Group owns United Breweries Ltd.

According to the terms set forth in the letter of intent, UB will invest $9 million in cash and $2 million in equity securities of its Kingfisher North America subsidiary, an exclusive right to manufacture Kingfisher beer for sale in North America and certain management and technical services.

Closing of the transaction is expected to occur by the end of 1996 or the first calendar quarter of 1997, subject to the negotiation and execution of a definitive investment agreement between the parties and other conditions.
